build_RegNet_backbone: build a RegNet backbone model with custom arch parameters for pose estimation feature extraction
run_RegNet_forward: run the RegNet forward pass on input tensors to extract multi-scale feature maps
generate_RegNet_widths: generate per-block widths and stage counts from RegNet parameters using generate_regnet static method
adjust_RegNet_width_group: adjust RegNet stage widths and group widths for compatibility using adjust_width_group method
get_RegNet_stages: get stage widths and block counts from per-block widths using get_stages_from_blocks method
